title: Ethics III · 1 — Willing and Unwilling Actions
description: When is something truly your doing? Aristotle separates forced acts and honest mistakes from everything else, which is yours. Full chapter read, with commentary.

title: Ethics III · 2 — What Choice Is
description: Choice is not desire, anger, wishing, or belief. Aristotle narrows it down until only one thing is left. Full chapter read, with commentary.

title: Ethics III · 3 — Thinking Things Through
description: We only deliberate about what is up to us, and we think about the route, not the destination. Aristotle on how good planning actually works. Full chapter read, with commentary.

title: Ethics III · 4 — What We Wish For
description: Do we wish for what is good, or for what only seems good? Aristotle's answer, the good person as a measuring stick, and why pleasure fools us. Full chapter read, with commentary.
